external_set: cptac_coad_external_manifest eligible_TP53==True (105 slides, 80 patients, all MSS); label_TP53 mut vs WT
features: mean-pooled tile features, pooled_means_phikon_uni.npz (Phikon 768-d, UNI v1 1024-d)
model: StandardScaler -> LogisticRegression(C=0.01, class_weight='balanced', max_iter=2000) - the 'linear' recipe already fixed in analyse_mut.py; fit once on all 324 dev slides
no_tuning: no threshold, hyperparameter or feature choice is revisited after the external labels are read
primary_metric: patient-level AUROC, patient score = mean of that patient's slide scores; 2000-draw patient bootstrap percentile 95% CI, seed 0
revision_note: First draft (C=1.0, label_tp53_coadread, n=321) gave dev CV 0.713/0.735 and did not reproduce the published 0.762/0.765; replaced by the project's existing recipe BEFORE any CPTAC TP53 label was read. Dev CV reproduced: phikon 0.762, uni 0.765.
secondary: confounder check: AUROC of tissue tile count alone
sensitivity: restrict to patients whose TP53 call is concordant between coad_cptac_2019 and GDC harmonised calls (TP53_gdc_concordant)
task: TP53 mutation, colorectal, external validation on CPTAC-COAD (single look)
train: mut_labels.csv, group Colorectal, partition=dev, crc_TP53 not null (324 patients: 207 mutant / 117 WT; MSS, non-hypermutated, IMPACT505 protein-altering calls)
